{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] ground [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]]
* [[Cookbook:Poultry Shake|Poultry Shake]]
* 4 hamburger buns
* [[Cookbook:Flour|Flour]]
* 2 ½ [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|peanut]] or [[Cookbook:Canola Oil|canola oil]]
* Freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]

== Procedure ==
#Form chicken into 4 equal patties, about ½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick. Season on both sides liberally with poultry shake. Set aside.
#Pour lemon juice into a [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie plate]] and place flour in another. Dip chicken into the lemon, then [[Cookbook:Dredging|dredge]] in flour. Tap off excess, then let sit 2–3 minutes.
#While chicken sits, heat oil in a deep fryer or cast-iron pot to 350°F. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F. Drain on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|wire rack]].
#Serve chicken on buns with desired toppings.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Suggested toppings include crispy [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], [[Cookbook:Barbecue Sauce|barbecue sauce]] (hopefully homemade), [[Cookbook:Sriracha|Sriracha]], [[Cookbook:Lettuce|lettuce]], [[Cookbook:Spinach|spinach]], [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]], [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]], ranch, and of course [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]] and [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]].
